description: This file is a shell script used for testing the diff of symlinks in a Git repository. It defines functions to compute short OIDs for symlinks and files, and contains multiple test cases to verify diff behaviors with symlinks, including creation, modification, deletion, and attribute handling.

methods.name: symlink_oid
methods.description: Computes the short OID of a symlink with the given name.

methods.name: short_oid
methods.description: Computes the short OID of a given file.
